SnackSaveToCloudDrive.description:
Upload images, a video or existing files to your own cloud drive, optionally end-to-end encrypted.

One-time setup: pick the drive, and the node shows what to fill in (Google Drive: a
Connect button). Credentials are stored on the ComfyUI machine, never in the workflow.
Encryption: create the vault once in a terminal on that machine:
  python custom_nodes/comfyui_snacknodes/auth.py vault-create r2

Usage
- Connect images and/or video; pick the drive.
- remote_folder: folder on the drive, created if missing. Date tokens:
  ComfyUI/%date:yyyy-MM-dd%  ->  ComfyUI/2026-11-01
  ComfyUI/%year%/%month%     ->  ComfyUI/2026/11
- encrypt: file contents and names are encrypted before upload (Cryptomator vault);
  open them with the Cryptomator app.
- preview: show the images on the node after the run.
- keep_local_copy: also keep the files in ComfyUI's output folder.
- Advanced: filename_prefix (local file names); stop_on_error off = keep going and
  output success = False instead of stopping the workflow.
- Outputs: remote_paths (one line per file) and success (True/False) for automation.
- file_paths (input): connect a text node listing files that already exist in the output
  folder, one per line, e.g. video/ComfyUI_00001_.mp4
Existing files are never overwritten (name_1, name_2 ...).

provider.name: provider
provider.tooltip: Which cloud drive to upload to. Connect it once in the panel that appears on the node.

remote_folder.name: remote_folder
remote_folder.tooltip: Folder on the drive (inside the vault when encrypting); created if missing. Date tokens: %date:yyyy-MM-dd%, %year%, %month%, %day%, %hour%, %minute%, %second% (server local time). Example: ComfyUI/%date:yyyy-MM%

encrypt.name: encrypt
encrypt.tooltip: Encrypt file contents and names before upload (Cryptomator vault format); open them with the Cryptomator app. Create the vault once with auth.py vault-create.

preview.name: preview
preview.tooltip: Show the saved images on the node after the run.

keep_local_copy.name: keep_local_copy
keep_local_copy.tooltip: On: also keep the files in ComfyUI's output folder. Off: use the temp folder (cleared when ComfyUI restarts).

filename_prefix.name: filename_prefix
filename_prefix.tooltip: Name prefix for saved images/videos, same as Save Image. A sub folder is allowed, e.g. portraits/ComfyUI

stop_on_error.name: stop_on_error
stop_on_error.tooltip: On: a failed upload stops the workflow with an error. Off: the workflow continues and the success output is False (for automation).

images.name: images
images.tooltip: Images to save as PNG and upload.

video.name: video
video.tooltip: Video to save as MP4 and upload.

file_paths.name: file_paths
file_paths.tooltip: Optional: connect a text node listing existing files to upload, one per line, relative to ComfyUI's output folder, e.g. video/ComfyUI_00001_.mp4

0.name: remote_paths
0.tooltip: One line per uploaded file: a share link when the drive provides one, otherwise provider:path.

1.name: success
1.tooltip: True when every file was uploaded. With stop_on_error off, a failed upload gives False instead of stopping the workflow, so you can branch on it.
